title: Electricity and Magnetism
summary: Grade 10: current and potential difference, Ohm's law, resistance and resistivity, series and parallel circuits, electric power and heating, magnetic fields of currents, motors and domestic circuits.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Understanding how charge flows and how currents interact with magnetic fields lets us power homes safely and efficiently.

conceptual: Why are homes wired in parallel?
How does a current create a force in a magnetic field?
debatable: Should electricity be priced higher at peak times to reduce demand?

cbseChapters: Class 10: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
